name: Exp_XBullsBearsEyes_Vol_Direct
summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the XBullsBearsEyes volatility indicator with a direct trading approach. It opens positions when the Bulls and Bears Eyes indicator signals a trend direction, using volume-weighted confirmation for entry. The EA manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the indicator's volatility calculations.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XBullsBearsEyes波动率指标进行直接交易。当牛熊之眼指标发出趋势方向信号时，使用成交量加权确认入场。EA通过指标波动率计算的止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用XBullsBearsEyes指标判断市场多空力量对比，该指标结合了波动率和成交量因素来衡量买卖双方的压力。入场条件为指标显示多头或空头力量占据主导地位时，顺势开仓。出场条件包括达到基于ATR或波动率计算的止损止盈水平，以及指标信号反转时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法。资金管理方面，EA通过波动率调整止损距离来控制单笔风险。整体策略属于趋势跟踪类型，在趋势确立后跟随方向交易，但依赖单一指标信号可能导致震荡行情中频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the XBullsBearsEyes indicator to gauge the balance of power between bulls and bears, which incorporates volatility and volume factors to measure buying and selling pressure. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator shows either bulls or bears dominating the market, opening positions in the prevailing direction. Exit conditions include reaching stop loss and take profit levels calculated from ATR or volatility-based measurements, as well as closing positions when the indicator signal reverses. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or a balance-proportional method based on account equity. Money management is handled through volatility-adjusted stop loss distances to control per-trade risk exposure. The overall strategy falls under trend following, trading in the direction of established trends, but reliance on a single indicator signal may result in frequent stop-outs during choppy or ranging market conditions.

parameters.description_en: Trade lot size on bullish signal

parameters.description_en: Trade lot size on bearish signal

parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理模式
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing: >=1 fixed lots, <1 fraction of balance

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比

pros: 结合波动率和成交量的多维指标信号，比单一价格指标更可靠
采用波动率调整止损距离，使止损更加合理并适应市场变化
支持固定手数和资金管理两种仓位模式，灵活性较好
pros_en: Multi-dimensional indicator signal combining volatility and volume is more reliable than single price-based indicators
Volatility-adjusted stop loss distances make stops more rational and adaptive to market conditions
Supports both fixed lot and money management position sizing modes for good flexibility
cons: 依赖单一指标信号，在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，可能在逆势中入场
没有显式的回撤控制或整体仓位限制，极端行情下风险较大
cons_en: Relies on a single indicator signal, prone to false signals and frequent losses in choppy markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, may enter positions against the higher timeframe trend
No explicit drawdown control or overall position limits, posing significant risk during extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认，例如在H1趋势方向确认后才在M15上入场
加入最大回撤限制和整体持仓风险控制机制
增加震荡行情过滤器，避免在横盘区间频繁交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, such as entering on M15 only after H1 trend direction is confirmed
Implement maximum drawdown limits and overall portfolio risk control mechanisms
Add a ranging market filter to avoid frequent trading during sideways consolidation periods

risk_points: 单一指标依赖可能在市场状态切换时产生连续亏损
缺乏全局回撤控制，连续亏损时无法自动停止交易
波动率止损在极端行情跳空时可能失效
risk_points_en: Single indicator dependency may produce consecutive losses during market regime shifts
Lacks global drawdown control, unable to automatically halt trading during losing streaks
Volatility-based stops may fail during extreme gap events
